tools.name: check_backing
tools.description: Read what a NEAR protocol owes (its own accounting view) and what it holds (each token's ft_balance_of) at the same block, so the answer is exact. Use before depositing into a protocol. Works for intents.near, contract.main.burrow.near (Rhea lending) and any contract implementing backed_solvency.

tools.name: intents_backing_summary
tools.description: The latest daily scan of every NEP-141 token in NEAR Intents (intents.near): how many are backed, which are under-backed and by how much, and why.

tools.name: checker_status
tools.description: What the on-chain Backed checker contract last recorded for a (protocol, token) pair: Healthy, Suspected or Confirmed breach, with owed, held and block.
